acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: digested overnight with trypsin 12.5 ng/μl solution in ammonium bicarbonate buffer 55 mM at 37 ◦C

fractionation_method.evidence: The final protein extracts (25 μg) were separated in 1D SDS-PAGE acrylamide gels (12%) and then reduced with DTT 10 mM, alkylated with iodoacetamide 50 mM, and digested overnight with trypsin 12.5 ng/μl solution in ammonium bicarbonate buffer 55 mM at 37 ◦C.

instrument.value: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer, Thermo Scientific
instrument.evidence: Both liquid chromatography (3000 RSLCnano chromatograph, Thermo Scientific) and mass spectrometry (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer, Thermo Scientific) were used for peptide analysis.
